heard: Sometime later Jesus went up to Jerusalem for a festival By the Sheep Gate there is a pool where five colonnades covered Blind and lame and paralyzed lay in these places waiting For the water to be stirred so they might be healed One man had been an invalid for thirty-eight long years Jesus saw him lying there and asked if he wanted well He had no one to help him in when the water was stirred While he was on his way, someone else would go down first Jesus
